entities.name: Table T1 – GS Fixed Income Share of Bond Assets by Category
entities.brief: Bond asset shares for select fixed income categories from 2010 to 2025
entities.description: Shows how investors adjusted their bond allocations among duration, credit, government, high yield, and inflation-protected segments, highlighting risk and duration preferences.

| Year | Category                                             | Share (%) |
|------|------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| 2010 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 3.4%      |
| 2012 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 4.6%      |
| 2018 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 3.8%      |
| 2022 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 4.2%      |
| 2024 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 7.3%      |
| 2025 | Long Duration Share of Bond Assets                   | 6.8%      |
| 2010 | Inflation-protected Share of Bond Assets             | 4.0%      |
| 2012 | Inflation-protected Share of Bond Assets             | 4.3%      |
| 2014 | Inflation-protected Share of Bond Assets             | 2.6%      |
| 2022 | Inflation-protected Share of Bond Assets             | 3.9%      |
| 2025 | Inflation-protected Share of Bond Assets             | 2.7%      |
| 2010 | IG Credit and Agg-Type Share of Bond Assets          | 40.5%     |
| 2015 | IG Credit and Agg-Type Share of Bond Assets          | 47.0%     |
| 2020 | IG Credit and Agg-Type Share of Bond Assets          | 51.0%     |
| 2025 | IG Credit and Agg-Type Share of Bond Assets          | 53.5%     |
| 2010 | Government-only Share of Bond Assets                 | 12.0%     |
| 2012 | Government-only Share of Bond Assets                 | 13.4%     |
| 2018 | Government-only Share of Bond Assets                 | 7.0%      |
| 2025 | Government-only Share of Bond Assets                 | 13.8%     |
| 2010 | High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Share of Bond Assets | 10.5%     |
| 2014 | High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Share of Bond Assets | 16.0%     |
| 2020 | High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Share of Bond Assets | 8.0%      |
| 2025 | High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Share of Bond Assets | 8.5%      |
| 2010 | Leveraged Loan Share of High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Assets | 5.5%      |
| 2014 | Leveraged Loan Share of High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Assets | 22.0%     |
| 2019 | Leveraged Loan Share of High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Assets | 25.0%     |
| 2020 | Leveraged Loan Share of High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Assets | 13.0%     |
| 2025 | Leveraged Loan Share of High Yield Bond and Leveraged Loan Assets | 21.0%     |
properties.key_insight: By 2025, Long Duration and IG Credit shares reached multi-year highs, Government-only shares rebounded, and High Yield and Inflation-protected shares underperformed amid volatility.

entities.name: Table T2 – GS Fixed Income Evolution of Fund Positioning 2010-2025
entities.brief: Annual bond asset share trends across fixed income categories
entities.description: Depicts multi-year shifts in bond asset shares, reflecting evolving investor sentiment toward quality, duration, and risk in fixed income markets.

properties.key_insight: Long Duration and IG Credit shares rose sharply to peaks by 2024-2025, Government-only shares rebounded, while High Yield and Leveraged Loan shares declined and Inflation-protected shares were volatile.
